propositions: Empirical plan-review end-to-end duration (n=78, provider-clean) yields p50=5.7m, p90=13.2m, p99=42.1m; current regime (n=20, since 2026-08-22) shows p50=12.6m, p90=17.6m, p99=94.4m.
Empirical gated-close end-to-end duration (n=38, provider-clean) yields p50=8.5m, p90=37.3m, p99=60.1m; current regime (n=10) shows p50=28.2m, p90=57.3m, p99=61.6m.

Inner-workflow sidecar metrics (plan n=1,514, completion n=683) understate user-visible duration because overlap/duplicate-judge work, pre-workflow setup (particularly commit_impact.referencing_commits and ticket-directory scans), and post-workflow I/O tail are excluded from metrics.total_ms.

Deterministic pre-workflow commit-reference scans in close_precheck._check_work_landed dominate the outer latency tail for impact-present closes, causing p99 tail to exceed 60 minutes despite inner verifier p50/p90/p99 of 1.6/3.1/4.9 minutes.

Recommended guidance ranges (padded p50×1.2 through p90×1.2): plan review about 15–22 minutes; gated close about 35–70 minutes, with p99 tail evidence and explicit caveat that inner model time is much shorter.
